title: Cego
bidPhase: Auction — declare to play, or pass. The first to declare becomes the declarer.
contractPhase: Choose your contract. Cego: lay down all but one card and take the blind — a gamble. Handspiel: keep your dealt hand.
contractCegoDesc: Cego: keep just 1 card, lay the rest down, and swap for the {{count}}-card blind. A gamble for a big score — but you cannot see the blind before choosing.
contractHandspielDesc: Handspiel: skip the blind and play your dealt hand as is. Safer, but the upside is smaller.
exchangePhase: Cego exchange — pick the 1 card to keep ({{count}}/1 selected). The other 10 are laid down and you take the blind.
exchangeKeep: Choose the single card to keep.

hint.contract_cego: Gamble on the blind — choose Cego
hint.lead_high: As the declarer, lead high to seize the initiative
hint.lead_low: As a defender, lead low to conserve strength
hint.follow_win: You can win this trick — take it
hint.follow_duck: Cannot win or not worth it — duck

tutorial.trickDisplay: The current trick. You must follow the led suit; if you cannot, you must play a trump (tarock); failing that, any card. The highest trump wins the trick.
tutorial.playerHand: Your hand. Click a legal card to select it. Cego is a 4-player trick-taker on the 54-card tarock deck (four 8-card suits with J/C/Q/K courts, 21 trumps, and the Sküs).
tutorial.playButton: Once a card is selected, play it with this button. In the auction you pass or declare; then choose Cego or Handspiel; if you chose Cego, keep 1 card in the exchange.
tutorial.info: Cego is a 4-player trick-taker on the 54-card Baden tarock deck. Once the auction settles the declarer, they choose Cego (keep just one card, lay down the rest, and take the 10-card blind — a gamble) or Handspiel (keep the dealt hand). The declarer plays 1-vs-3 and wins the deal by capturing more than half of the card-points. The player with the highest cumulative score after the set number of deals wins.
tutorial.resetButton: Use the reset button to start a new game.
